feel: Create a component + Repeat (Ctrl+Shift+D) gave me 6 linked items in seconds; texts stay per item, style is shared.
The status line is excellent: Border of Seção 9 — it reaches testimonial and its 6 copies.
But the copies are named Seção 5…9: nothing in the Layers or the breadcrumb says they are the testimonial component.
The floating Layers survived the reload (workspace saved); only View › Reset workspace freed the canvas.
wish: Instances named after their component (testimonial 2…) with a component badge in the Layers.
A component editing mode (edit the master in isolation).

issues.what: Component instances keep generic names (Seção 5…9) with no component badge in Layers/breadcrumb
A floating panel state is persisted with the workspace; the only exit is View › Reset workspace (nothing points to it)

notes: Includes Reset workspace (to recover from the stuck floating Layers of D1) and one misplaced border undone.
